description:
This file is a shell script used for testing and managing git maintenance operations, including registration, scheduling, and execution of various maintenance tasks like garbage collection, repacking, and pruning within a git repository.
It contains function definitions, test cases, and commands for manipulating maintenance scheduling tools on different platforms, as well as handling configuration and validation of maintenance strategies.

methods.name: run_incremental_repack_and_verify
methods.description: Runs a sequence of git commits and repacks, then verifies that the incremental-repack process behaves as expected with different auto configurations.

methods.name: run_and_verify_geometric_pack
methods.description: Performs a geometric pack verification by running maintenance tasks and checking the number of pack files and absence of loose objects.

methods.name: test_geometric_repack_needed
methods.description: Checks whether a geometric repack is needed based on the current repository state and configuration.

methods.name: test_strategy
methods.description: Verifies that the specified maintenance strategy executes the correct set of commands and subprocess calls, including strategy-specific behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_worktree_prune
methods.description: Tests the worktree prune maintenance task with optional automatic pruning based on provided arguments.

methods.name: test_expect_rerere_gc
methods.description: Tests the rerere gc maintenance task execution with optional auto mode, and checks if garbage collection of rerere cache occurs.
